258	  τ.map fun s =>
259	    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
260	    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
261	    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
262	      | none => []
263	      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
264	        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
265	        | none => none
266	    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }
267	
268	private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
269	  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
270	  if obs.isEmpty then []
271	  else
272	    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
273	      if (footprint s t).isNone then
274	        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
275	      else none
276	    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
277	      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
278	        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
279	      else none
280	    bodies ++ unbounded
281	
282	private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
283	  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
284	  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
285	    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
286	    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
287	      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
288	      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
289	      else match q0, q1 with
290	        | some a, some b =>
291	          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
292	            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
293	          else []
294	        | _, _ => []
295	
296	/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
297	def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero
298	
299	/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
300	def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0
301	
302	private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
303	  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
304	    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
305	      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
306	      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
307	        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
308	        else
309	          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
310	          if wholeTurns turn then none
311	          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
312	      | _, _, _ => none
313	
314	/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
315	    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
316	def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
317	  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ
318	
319	/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
320	def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
321	  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
322	    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ
323	
324	/-- Every defect of the witness instant: `at` is a scene's timestamp, and every grounded track and
325	    every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene. -/
326	def checkWitness (τ : Trace) (grounding : List (String × TrackId)) (entities : List (String × Val)) (at_ms : Timestamp) : List String :=
327	  match τ.find? (·.t == at_ms) with
328	  | none => [s!"at {at_ms} is not the timestamp of any scene"]
329	  | some s =>
330	    (grounding.filterMap fun (b, t) =>
331	      if s.tracks.contains t then none else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: binder {b} is grounded to track {t}, which is not in this scene")
332	    ++ entities.filterMap fun (n, v) =>
333	      if present s v.kind (match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d) then none
334	      else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: entity {n} is {kindName v.kind} {match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d}, which is not in this scene"
335	
336	end TraceLint
337	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.TraceLint
  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is
  run on it. It reads the trace and, for the witness check, a grounding, a case's entities and one
  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in
  rational arithmetic, with no tolerance: a written trace has no measurement noise, and its author
  is shown these rules. Traces a source records are never held to it.

  `checkTrace` requires:
  - identity: track, region and device ids unique within a scene; at most one measured relation
    per ordered pair of tracks within a scene; every reference a scene makes (`Scene.references`)
    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
    appears in some scene;
  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
    occupies both;
  - path length: between consecutive observations of a track's path length it never decreases,
    and its increase is at least the straight-line distance between the two positions;
  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).
  `checkReferences` is the identity part alone. A witness trace is held to the whole check, after
  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.

  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace TraceLint

private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
private def kindName : EntityKind → String
  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
  match ks.reverse with
  | [] => ""
  | [k] => k.toString
  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"

/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
  match k with
  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
  | .device => (s.device id).isSome

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity and references
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
    if !present s r.kind r.id then
      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"

private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The static map and the devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  match τ with
  | [] => []
  | s0 :: _ =>
    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
    τ.flatMap fun s =>
      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
        | none => none

private def devices (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let ids := (τ.flatMap fun s => s.devices.map (·.id)).eraseDups
  let first := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? (·.device d)
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (ids.filterMap fun d => match first d with
      | some dv => if !dv.mobile && (s.device d).isNone then some s!"{at_ s}: device {d} is missing; a device that does not move is in every scene" else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.devices.filterMap fun dv => match first dv.id with
      | some d0 =>
        if reprStr d0.staticPart != reprStr dv.staticPart then
          some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} differs from its first appearance in a field that is not its state (its state is {String.intercalate ", " Device.stateFields}{if d0.mobile then ", position" else ""})"
        else none
      | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Representation: where a designated direction and a device's control are written
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The structure kinds a vehicle travels in that may carry a designated direction. A centre turn
    lane, shared by both directions, carries none. -/
def directionKinds : List StructureKind :=
  [.lane, .reservedLane, .turnLane, .bicycleLaneOrPath, .roadway, .oneWayRoadway, .shoulder]

/-- The structure kinds a device may govern: the kinds refining the travel region, the regions
    whose traffic it controls and an intersection, read as control of the junction itself and of
    nothing else. -/
def governedKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => !k.isAbstract && k.refines .travelRegion

/-- The structure kinds that mark a carrier's entrance into an intersection. -/
def entranceKinds : List StructureKind := [.stopLine, .crosswalk]

/-- The structure kinds that carry an entrance into an intersection: those of
    `StructureKind.entranceCarriers` and every kind refining one of them. -/
def carrierKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => StructureKind.entranceCarriers.any (k.refines ·)

/-- The kinds a region may have at each region argument of an atom or primitive, keyed by its Lean
    name and the argument's index in its full argument list: `some ks` where the field the name reads
    there is carried by, or may name, only a region whose kind is in `ks` (the lists this check and
    `Scene.references` hold the field to); `none` where a region of any kind may stand there. A class
    atom `st_<kind>` reads the label every region has and is `none`. -/
def regionArgKinds : List ((String × Nat) × Option (List StructureKind)) :=
  let refining := fun (ks : List StructureKind) => StructureKind.all.filter fun k => ks.any (k.refines ·)
  [(("st_lane_enters", 0), some carrierKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 0), some entranceKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 1), some (refining StructureKind.entranceCarriers)),
   (("st_lane_direction", 0), some directionKinds),
   (("dev_governs", 1), some governedKinds),
   (("st_sight_along_way", 1), some (refining StructureKind.sightWays)),
   (("prim_region_offset_along", 2), some directionKinds)]
  ++ ([("st_lane_enters", 1), ("rel_occupies", 1), ("st_road_edge_paved", 0), ("st_shoulder_paved", 0),
       ("st_median_or_divider_opening", 0), ("st_crosswalk_marked", 0), ("st_reserved_lane_class", 0),
       ("st_turn_lane_side", 0), ("st_parking_space_designation", 0), ("st_curb_zone_kind", 0),
       ("st_curb_zone_colour", 0), ("st_obstruction_kind", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 2),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 1), ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 1), ("st_lane_connectivity", 0), ("st_lane_connectivity", 1), ("st_on_way", 0),
       ("st_on_way", 1), ("st_lane_marking", 0), ("st_lane_marking_left", 0), ("st_lane_marking_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_count", 0), ("st_lane_width", 0), ("st_curvature", 0),
       ("st_grade", 0), ("st_sight_distance", 0), ("st_parking_space_angle", 0), ("st_region_geometry", 0),
       ("st_region_geometry_distance", 1), ("prim_region_lateral_offset", 1), ("prim_region_offset_along", 1)]
      ++ StructureKind.all.map fun k => (s!"st_{k}", 0)).map (·, none)

private def representation (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstStructure := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s.t
  let firstDevice := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.device d).map fun _ => s.t
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
      -- the map is static, so each structure is reported once, at its first appearance
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t then []
      else match st.lane.bind (·.direction) with
        | none => []
        | some v =>
          (if directionKinds.contains st.kind then []
           else [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.direction; only a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder does"])
          ++ (if Q.isZero v.1 && Q.isZero v.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} lane.direction is the zero vector"] else []))
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || (st.lane.bind (·.entersIntersection)).isNone || carrierKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.enters_intersection; only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind refining one, enters an intersection as an approach")
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || !st.entranceObserved || entranceKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries entrance_of; only a stop line or a crosswalk marks an entrance")
    ++ s.devices.flatMap fun dv =>
      if firstDevice dv.id != some s.t || !dv.governsObserved then []
      else dv.governs.filterMap fun r => match s.structure? r with
        | some st =>
          if governedKinds.contains st.kind then none
          else some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} governs structure {r} ({st.kind.toString}); a device governs the travel regions whose traffic it controls (a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, centre turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder) or an intersection"
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- What is wrong with a boundary, or nothing. -/
def boundaryErrors (poly : List Vec) : List String :=
  if poly.length < 3 then ["has fewer than three vertices"]
  else if !(dups poly).isEmpty then ["repeats a vertex (the first vertex is not repeated at the end)"]
  else if Q.isZero (Geom.area2 poly) then ["has zero area"]
  else if Geom.selfIntersects poly then ["intersects itself"]
  else []

private def geometry (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstOf := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      -- a structure is static, so its boundary is reported once, at its first appearance
      if (firstOf st.id).map (·.t) != some s.t then none
      else match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => match boundaryErrors poly with
          | [] => none
          | e :: _ => some s!"{at_ s}: the boundary of structure {st.id} {e}"
        | none => none)
    ++ (s.relations.filterMap fun m => match m.surfaceGap with
      | some (lon, lat) =>
        if Q.lt lon Q.zero || Q.lt lat Q.zero then
          some s!"{at_ s}: relation ({m.a}, {m.b}) surface_gap ({qs lon}, {qs lat}) has a negative component; each component is a distance between the bodies' nearest points, along and across a's heading, zero on contact or overlap"
        else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.tracks.flatMap fun x =>
      (match kin_extent s x with
       | some (l, w, _) => if Q.le l Q.zero || Q.le w Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} extent: the half-length and the half-width must be positive"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_path_length s x with
       | some p => if Q.lt p Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} path_length {qs p} is negative"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_heading s x with
       | some h => if Q.isZero h.1 && Q.isZero h.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} heading is the zero vector"] else []
       | none => [])

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy, path length, heading against yaw rate
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The trace with the occupancy of every observed track derived from the geometry: in each scene,
    for a track in `occupancy_observed` whose footprint is defined, `occupies` holds the pair
    (track, structure) exactly when the footprint and the structure's valid boundary overlap as
    closed sets; what the trace listed for that track is replaced, every other pair kept. -/
def completeOccupancy (τ : Trace) : Trace :=
  τ.map fun s =>
    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
      | none => []
      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
        | none => none
    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }

private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
  if obs.isEmpty then []
  else
    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
      if (footprint s t).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
      else none
    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
      else none
    bodies ++ unbounded

private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
      else match q0, q1 with
        | some a, some b =>
          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
          else []
        | _, _ => []

/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero

/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0

private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
        else
          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
          if wholeTurns turn then none
          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
      | _, _, _ => none

/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ

/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ

/-- Every defect of the witness instant: `at` is a scene's timestamp, and every grounded track and
    every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene. -/
def checkWitness (τ : Trace) (grounding : List (String × TrackId)) (entities : List (String × Val)) (at_ms : Timestamp) : List String :=
  match τ.find? (·.t == at_ms) with
  | none => [s!"at {at_ms} is not the timestamp of any scene"]
  | some s =>
    (grounding.filterMap fun (b, t) =>
      if s.tracks.contains t then none else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: binder {b} is grounded to track {t}, which is not in this scene")
    ++ entities.filterMap fun (n, v) =>

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
  What a trace must satisfy, as written, before any rule is evaluated on it: the declared facts
  (assumptions and intentions) name what their scene holds, each once, by well-formed ids; no
  structure is labelled with an abstract kind or lists one among the kinds its source cannot tell
  (an abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it, read only by a formula); and the
  accepted re-identification links are one-to-one.

  The checks are exact and read no geometry, so a recorded trace, a JSON case and a Lean witness
  are held to them alike. `Grounding.Setup.admit` calls them; every evaluation builds its setup
  there.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Identity
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Admission

private def duplicates {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups

/-- The defects of one scene's declared facts. -/
def sceneDefects (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let at_ := s!"scene t={s.t}"
  (s.intents.flatMap fun d =>
    let who := s!"{at_}: intent record ({d.vehicle}, {d.target})"
    (if s.tracks.contains d.vehicle then [] else [s!"{who}: vehicle {d.vehicle} is not a road user of the scene"]) ++
    (if (s.structure? d.target).isSome then [] else [s!"{who}: target {d.target} is not a structure of the scene"]) ++
    ((duplicates (d.values.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` listed more than once") ++
    ((d.values.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!IntId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` is not a well-formed intention id")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.intents.map fun d => (d.vehicle, d.target))).map fun (v, r) => s!"{at_}: more than one intent record for ({v}, {r})") ++
  (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
    (if st.kind.isAbstract then [s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} is labelled `{st.kind}`, an abstract kind; label it with a kind that refines `{st.kind}`"] else []) ++
    ((st.unobservedKinds.filter (·.isAbstract)).eraseDups.map fun k =>
      s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} lists `{k}` among unobserved_kinds, an abstract kind; list the kinds refining it that the source cannot tell")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.assumptions.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{at_}: assumption `{id}` listed more than once") ++
  ((s.assumptions.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!AsmId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{at_}: `{id}` is not a well-formed assumption id")

/-- Accepted links that give a track two successors or two predecessors. -/
def linkDefects (τ : Array Scene) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  let links := Grounding.acceptedLinks τ gap
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.1))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} is continued by more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.1 == t)}") ++
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.2))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} continues more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.2 == t)}")

/-- Every defect of the trace as written; empty for a trace every evaluation may read. -/
def defects (τ : Trace) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap sceneDefects ++ linkDefects τ.toArray gap

end Admission
end TrafficSpec

  bearing : Option Vec := none               -- b relative to a, in a's frame (long, lat)
  contact : Option Bool := none
  visible : Option Bool := none              -- b in a's line of sight
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A source's declaration current at a scene for one road user at one target region: each id
    listed true or false, an id the declaration does not decide left out. -/
structure DeclaredIntent where
  vehicle : TrackId
  target : RegionId
  values : List (IntId × Bool)
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure Scene where
  t : Timestamp
  subject : Option TrackId := none
  users : List RoadUser := []
  structures : List Structure := []
  devices : List Device := []
  /-- The tracks whose occupancy was observed: for them every region not listed in `occupies` is
      not occupied; for any other track `rel.occupies` is unknown. -/
  occupancyObserved : List TrackId := []
  occupies : List (TrackId × RegionId) := []
  relations : List MeasuredRelation := []
  env : Env := {}
  assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []
  intents : List DeclaredIntent := []
  links : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A trace: scenes in strictly increasing time. -/
abbrev Trace := List Scene

namespace Scene
def user (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option RoadUser := s.users.find? (·.track == x)
def structure? (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option Structure := s.structures.find? (·.id == r)
def device (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Device := s.devices.find? (·.id == d)
def relation (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option MeasuredRelation :=
  s.relations.find? (fun m => m.a == a && m.b == b)
def tracks (s : Scene) : List TrackId := s.users.map (·.track)
end Scene

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Projections a trace check reads, so that it names no field of these records itself. A field a
-- split may omit is named on a line of its own.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- A reference a scene makes to an entity: where it is written, the kind of entity it names, the
    id, and the structure kinds of which that entity must have one (by refinement) when the field
    requires one. -/
structure Reference where
  place : String
  kind : EntityKind
  id : Nat
  structureKinds : List StructureKind := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Structure
/-- The regions a structure's own fields name: its lane's neighbours, successors and intersection,
    the ways it lies on, and the carriers whose entrance it marks. -/
def references (st : Structure) : List Reference :=
  let at_ := fun (f : String) => s!"structure {st.id} {f}"
  (st.lane.bind (·.leftNeighbour)).toList.map (fun r => { place := at_ "lane.left", kind := .region, id := r })
  ++ (st.lane.bind (·.rightNeighbour)).toList.map (fun r => { place := at_ "lane.right", kind := .region, id := r })
  ++ ((st.lane.bind (·.leadsTo)).getD []).map (fun r => { place := at_ "lane.leads_to", kind := .region, id := r })
  ++ (st.lane.bind (·.entersIntersection)).toList.map (fun r => { place := at_ "lane.enters_intersection", kind := .region, id := r })
  ++ (st.ways.getD []).map (fun r => { place := at_ "ways", kind := .region, id := r })
  ++ st.entranceOf.map (fun r => { place := at_ "entrance_of", kind := .region, id := r, structureKinds := StructureKind.entranceCarriers })
end Structure

namespace Scene
/-- Every reference the scene makes to an entity, each of which must be present in the scene. -/
def references (s : Scene) : List Reference :=
  (s.subject.toList.map fun t => { place := "subject", kind := .track, id := t })
  ++ (s.occupies.flatMap fun (t, r) => [{ place := "occupies", kind := .track, id := t }, { place := "occupies", kind := .region, id := r }])
  ++ (s.occupancyObserved.map fun t => { place := "occupancy_observed", kind := .track, id := t })
  ++ (s.relations.flatMap fun m => [{ place := "relations[].a", kind := .track, id := m.a }, { place := "relations[].b", kind := .track, id := m.b }])
  ++ (s.devices.flatMap fun d => d.governs.map fun r => { place := s!"device {d.id} governs", kind := .region, id := r })
  ++ (s.structures.flatMap Structure.references)
  ++ (s.users.flatMap fun u => (u.sightAlongWay.getD []).map fun (w, _) =>
       { place := s!"user {u.track} sight_along_way", kind := .region, id := w, structureKinds := StructureKind.sightWays })
end Scene

namespace Device
/-- The fields of a device that may change between scenes: the state it displays or senses (JSON keys). -/
def stateFields : List String := [
  "indications",
  "uncovered",
  "inoperative",
  "ped_state",
  "countdown",
  "lane_control",
  "flashing",
  "active",
  "rail_lights",
  "gate",
  "bell",
  "human_indication",
  ]

/-- A device that moves: one carried by a road user, or a person directing traffic. Its position is
    state too. -/
def mobile (d : Device) : Bool :=
  d.kind == .humanDirection

/-- The device without its state: what is the same at every appearance of the device. -/
def staticPart (d : Device) : Device :=
  { d with
    position := if d.mobile then none else d.position
    indications := none
    uncovered := none
    inoperative := none
    pedState := none
    countdown := none
    laneControl := none
    flashing := none
    active := none
    railLights := none
    gate := none
    bell := none
    humanIndication := none
    }
end Device

namespace Trace
def timestamps (τ : Trace) : List Timestamp := τ.map (·.t)
def monotone (τ : Trace) : Bool :=
  match τ with
  | a :: b :: rest => a.t < b.t && monotone (b :: rest)
  | _ => true
end Trace

end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
  Typed reasons for an unknown verdict, and the three-valued result that carries them.

  A monitor that says `unknown` without saying why is useless for diagnosis. Every place that
  produces `u` attaches a reason; the connectives keep the reasons of their unknown operands and
  drop them once a value is decided.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Tri
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Handles

namespace TrafficSpec

inductive UnknownReason
  | absentAtom (name : String)            -- the source did not observe this atom for this entity
  | samplingGap (op : String)             -- observations too sparse for the window
  | windowTruncated (op : String)         -- the window reaches past the start or end of the trace
  | identityGap (track : TrackId)         -- a bound track is not present and no link continues it
  | assumptionMissing (id : AsmId)        -- an `asm.*` the scene did not supply
  | intentionMissing (id : IntId)         -- an `int.*` the scene did not declare for the road user at the region
  | parameterMissing (name : String)      -- a reading parameter the rule names but the reading lacks
  | unboundVariable (name : String)       -- a formula variable with no binding
  | compositionUnknown (rule : String)    -- a composed rule reported unknown or does not exist
  | outOfRange                            -- an index outside the trace
  | divisionByZero (what : String)
  | malformed (what : String)             -- a literal that names no enumeration value, wrong arity
  | undefined (concept : String)          -- the concept's precondition does not hold here (e.g. a multi-lane configuration)
  | aggregateUnresolved (id : String)     -- the posted definition of the aggregate decides neither inclusion nor exclusion of the road user's class
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace UnknownReason
/-- A stable spelling for reports and histograms. -/
def tag : UnknownReason → String
  | .absentAtom n => s!"absent_atom:{n}"
  | .samplingGap op => s!"sampling_gap:{op}"
  | .windowTruncated op => s!"window_truncated:{op}"
  | .identityGap t => s!"identity_gap:{t}"
  | .assumptionMissing id => s!"assumption_missing:{id}"
  | .intentionMissing id => s!"intention_missing:{id}"
  | .parameterMissing n => s!"parameter_missing:{n}"
  | .unboundVariable n => s!"unbound_variable:{n}"
  | .compositionUnknown r => s!"composition_unknown:{r}"
  | .outOfRange => "out_of_range"
  | .divisionByZero w => s!"division_by_zero:{w}"
  | .malformed w => s!"malformed:{w}"
  | .undefined c => s!"undefined:{c}"
  | .aggregateUnresolved id => s!"aggregate_unresolved:{id}"
instance : ToString UnknownReason := ⟨tag⟩
end UnknownReason

/-- A three-valued result with the reasons behind an unknown one. -/
structure R where
  v : Tri
  why : List UnknownReason := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace R
def t : R := ⟨.t, []⟩
def f : R := ⟨.f, []⟩
def u (w : UnknownReason) : R := ⟨.u, [w]⟩
def ofBool (b : Bool) : R := ⟨Tri.ofBool b, []⟩
def ofOption (o : Option Bool) (w : UnknownReason) : R :=
  match o with
  | some b => ofBool b
  | none => u w
/-- Reasons are kept only while the value is undecided. -/
def settle (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : R := ⟨v, if v = .u then why.eraseDups else []⟩
@[simp] theorem settle_v (v : Tri) (why : List UnknownReason) : (settle v why).v = v := rfl
def and (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.and a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def or (a b : R) : R := settle (Tri.or a.v b.v) (a.why ++ b.why)
def not (a : R) : R := ⟨Tri.not a.v, a.why⟩
@[simp] theorem and_v (a b : R) : (and a b).v = Tri.and a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem or_v (a b : R) : (or a b).v = Tri.or a.v b.v := rfl
@[simp] theorem not_v (a : R) : (not a).v = Tri.not a.v := rfl
def implies (a b : R) : R := or (not a) b
def all (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl and t
def any (xs : List R) : R := xs.foldl or f
/-- Lift an `Option α` into a computation that is unknown when the option is empty. -/
def bindOpt {α : Type} (o : Option α) (w : UnknownReason) (k : α → R) : R :=
  match o with
  | some a => k a
  | none => u w
end R

/-- A quantity that may be unknown, with the reason. -/
abbrev QR := Except UnknownReason Q

/-- Kleene conjunction and disjunction over index ranges of a per-instant array in O(1) each,
    from prefix counts and next-unknown pointers. Reasons come from the earliest unknown in range. -/
structure RangeAgg where
  vals : Array R
  prefF : Array Nat      -- prefF[i] = number of false values before index i
  prefT : Array Nat
  prefU : Array Nat
  nextU : Array Nat      -- nextU[i] = smallest k ≥ i with an unknown value (size when none)

namespace RangeAgg
def build (vals : Array R) : RangeAgg :=
  let n := vals.size
  let count (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
    (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if vals[i]!.v = .u then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  ⟨vals, count (· = .f), count (· = .t), count (· = .u), nextU⟩

private def cnt (pref : Array Nat) (lo hi : Nat) : Nat := pref[hi + 1]! - pref[lo]!
private def firstUnknown (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : List UnknownReason :=
  let k := a.nextU[lo]!
  if k ≤ hi then a.vals[k]!.why else []

/-- ∧ over `lo … hi` inclusive; true on an empty range. -/
def all (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefF lo hi > 0 then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.t
/-- ∨ over `lo … hi` inclusive; false on an empty range. -/
def any (a : RangeAgg) (lo hi : Nat) : R :=
  if hi < lo then R.f
  else if cnt a.prefT lo hi > 0 then R.t
  else if cnt a.prefU lo hi > 0 then ⟨.u, a.firstUnknown lo hi⟩
  else R.f

/-- The number of values among the first `m` that satisfy `p`: what `build` stores at `m`. -/
def countTo (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | m + 1 => countTo vals p m + (if p vals[m]!.v then 1 else 0)

private theorem count_fold (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (k : Nat) :
    ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i => acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0]).size = k + 1 ∧
    ∀ m, m ≤ k → ((List.range k).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
      acc.push (acc[i]! + (if p vals[i]!.v then 1 else 0))) #[0])[m]! = countTo vals p m := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [countTo]
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hv⟩ := ih
    simp only [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun m hm => ?_⟩
    rw [getElem!_pos _ m (by simp; omega), Array.getElem_push]
    split
    · rw [← getElem!_pos _ m (by omega)]; exact hv m (by omega)
    · obtain rfl : m = k + 1 := by omega
      simp only [countTo]; rw [hv k (Nat.le_refl _)]

theorem countTo_mono (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) {a b : Nat} (h : a ≤ b) :
    countTo vals p a ≤ countTo vals p b := by
  induction b with
  | zero => cases h; exact Nat.le_refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge a (b + 1) with h' | h'
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih (by omega)) (by simp only [countTo]; omega)
    · obtain rfl : a = b + 1 := by omega
      exact Nat.le_refl _

/-- The count rises between `lo` and `n` exactly when a value at an index in `[lo, n)` satisfies `p`. -/
theorem countTo_lt_iff (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) (lo n : Nat) :
    countTo vals p lo < countTo vals p n ↔ ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j < n ∧ p vals[j]!.v := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [countTo] at h
    | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hp : p vals[n]!.v
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge n lo with h' | h'
        · have := countTo_mono vals p (show n + 1 ≤ lo by omega); omega
        · exact ⟨n, h', Nat.lt_succ_self _, hp⟩
      · simp only [countTo, hp] at h
        obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (by simpa using h)
        exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, h3⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩
    have a := countTo_mono vals p h1
    have b := countTo_mono vals p (show j + 1 ≤ n by omega)
    have c : countTo vals p (j + 1) = countTo vals p j + 1 := by simp [countTo, h3]
    omega

private theorem cnt_build_f (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (hl : lo ≤ hi) (h : hi < vals.size) :
    cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi = countTo vals (· = .f) (hi + 1) - countTo vals (· = .f) lo := by
  have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
  simp only [cnt, build]
  rw [hf.2 (hi + 1) (by omega), hf.2 lo (by omega)]

/-- `all` is false only on a definite false in the range. -/
theorem all_f_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi : Nat) (h : ((build vals).all lo hi).v = .f) :
    ∃ j, lo ≤ j ∧ j ≤ hi ∧ j < vals.size ∧ vals[j]!.v = .f := by
  have hl : lo ≤ hi := by
    refine Nat.le_of_not_lt fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, hn, if_true] at h
    exact absurd h (by decide)
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn => ?_
    simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hn, Nat.lt_irrefl] at h
    split at h <;> simp [R.t] at h
  have hhi : hi < vals.size := by
    refine Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hn => ?_
    have hf := count_fold vals (· = .f) vals.size
    have : (build vals).prefF[hi + 1]! = 0 := by
      simp only [build]; rw [getElem!_neg]; · rfl
      rw [hf.1]; omega
    simp only [cnt, this] at hc
    omega
  rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi hl hhi] at hc
  obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).1 (by omega)
  exact ⟨j, h1, by omega, by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- A definite false in a range inside the array makes `all` false. -/
theorem all_f_of_witness (vals : Array R) (lo hi j : Nat) (hhi : hi < vals.size) (hlo : lo ≤ j) (hj : j ≤ hi)
    (hf : vals[j]!.v = .f) : (build vals).all lo hi = R.f := by
  have hc : cnt (build vals).prefF lo hi > 0 := by
    rw [cnt_build_f vals lo hi (by omega) hhi]
    have := (countTo_lt_iff vals (· = .f) lo (hi + 1)).2 ⟨j, hlo, by omega, by simp [hf]⟩
    omega
  simp only [all, show ¬ hi < lo by omega, if_false, hc, if_true]
end RangeAgg

end TrafficSpec

/-- The atom a window over a measure reads: the clock, or the subject's path length. -/
def measureAtom : Measure → String

    `st_lane`); a variable kind is a concept's literal formal, read once the instance fills it. -/

-- measure of every window, and the kind of every quantifier with a literal kind.
mutual
  partial def termAtoms : Term → List String

    | .quantity c _ ps => c :: (ps.flatMap termAtoms)

    | .sinceRise φ => measureAtom .time :: atoms φ

    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCompositions g ++ compositions ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => compositions φ ++ termCompositions t

    | .neg a | .abs a => termCompositions a
    | .cond φ a b => compositions φ ++ termCompositions a ++ termCompositions b
    | _ => []

    | .rule id map | .ruleApplies id map => [(id, map)]
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termCompositions
    | .cmp l _ r => termCompositions l ++ termCompositions r

    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => compositions φ ++ compositions ψ

    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termCompositions d ++ compositions φ ++ compositions ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termCompositions d ++ compositions ψ ++ compositions φ

    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ

-- Numeric literals other than zero, with their units: what the gate holds against the node's
-- declared parameters (a magnitude belongs in the reading, not in a rule).
mutual

    | .sinceRise φ => literals φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termLiterals g ++ literals ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => literals φ ++ termLiterals t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termLiterals a
    | .cond φ a b => literals φ ++ termLiterals a ++ termLiterals b
    | _ => []
  partial def literals : Formula → List (Q × PUnit')

    | .cmp l _ r => termLiterals l ++ termLiterals r

    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termLiterals d ++ literals φ ++ literals ψ

    | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap termLiterals
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ

/-- A leaf is a subformula that reads the world or another rule: an atom, a comparison, an
    assumption, a derived concept or a composition. Leaves are numbered in traversal order. -/
def isLeaf : Formula → Bool
  | .atom .. | .cmp .. | .asm _ | .intent .. | .derived .. | .rule .. | .ruleApplies .. => true
  | _ => false

/-- The leaves in traversal order, as a description each. -/
partial def leaves : Formula → List String
  | .atom n args _ => [s!"atom {n} {repr args}"]
  | .cmp l _ r => [s!"cmp {repr l} {repr r}"]
  | .asm id => [s!"asm {id}"]
  | .intent id who target => [s!"intent {id} {repr who} {repr target}"]
  | .derived n args _ => [s!"derived {n} {repr args}"]
  | .rule id _ => [s!"rule {id}"]
  | .ruleApplies id _ => [s!"ruleApplies {id}"]
  | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => leaves φ
  | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ

  | .untilWithin _ _ _ φ ψ => leaves φ ++ leaves ψ
  | .atLast _ _ _ ψ φ => leaves ψ ++ leaves φ
  | .count e s _ _ => leaves e ++ leaves s
  | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
  | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => leaves φ
  | _ => []

def leafCount (φ : Formula) : Nat := (leaves φ).length

/-- The formula with its `k`-th leaf (traversal order) replaced by `r`, and the number of leaves
    in the formula. A subformula whose leaves all precede or follow the `k`-th is returned as it is. -/
partial def replaceLeafAux (k : Nat) (r : Formula) : Formula → Formula × Nat
  | φ@(.atom ..) | φ@(.cmp ..) | φ@(.asm _) | φ@(.intent ..) | φ@(.derived ..) | φ@(.rule ..) | φ@(.ruleApplies ..) =>
    (if k = 0 then r else φ, 1)
  | .not φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.not φ', n)
  | .always φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.always φ', n)
  | .eventually φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.eventually φ', n)
  | .and φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.and φ' ψ', n)
  | .or φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.or φ' ψ', n)
  | .implies φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.implies φ' ψ', n)
  | .until φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.until φ' ψ', n)
  | .since φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.since φ' ψ', n)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.holdsFor m d s φ', n)
  | .within m d s φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.within m d s φ', n)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => let (φ', ψ', n) := two k r φ ψ; (.untilWithin m d s φ' ψ', n)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => let (ψ', φ', n) := two k r ψ φ; (.atLast m d s ψ' φ', n)
  | .count e s op c => let (e', s', n) := two k r e s; (.count e' s' op c, n)
  | .rises φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.rises φ', n)
  | .definedWhen p φ => let (p', φ', n) := two k r p φ; (.definedWhen p' φ', n)
  | .existsRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .forallRegion kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallRegion kd v φ', n)
  | .existsDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsDevice kd v φ', n)
  | .forallDevice kd v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallDevice kd v φ', n)
  | .existsUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.existsUser v φ', n)
  | .forallUser v φ => let (φ', n) := replaceLeafAux k r φ; (.forallUser v φ', n)
  | φ => (φ, 0)

  two (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ ψ : Formula) : Formula × Formula × Nat :=

def replaceLeaf (k : Nat) (r : Formula) (φ : Formula) : Formula := (replaceLeafAux k r φ).1

-- The assumptions and the declared intentions a formula reads, at any depth of formulas and terms.
mutual
  partial def termDeclared : Term → List (Sum AsmId IntId)

    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termDeclared g ++ declared ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => declared φ ++ termDeclared t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termDeclared a ++ termDeclared b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termDeclared a

    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds φ ++ aggregateIds ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => termAggregateIds d ++ aggregateIds ψ ++ aggregateIds φ

    | _ => []
end

/-- The first `cond` of a term reachable through arithmetic (not inside an aggregate or a window,
    whose body ranges over its own variable or instants), with the term rebuilt on each branch. -/
partial def splitCond : Term → Option (Formula × Term × Term)
  | .cond φ a b => some (φ, a, b)
  | .add x y => two .add x y
  | .sub x y => two .sub x y
  | .mul x y => two .mul x y
  | .div x y => two .div x y
  | .neg x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .neg a, .neg b)
  | .abs x => (splitCond x).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, .abs a, .abs b)
  | _ => none
where
  two (k : Term → Term → Term) (x y : Term) : Option (Formula × Term × Term) :=
    match splitCond x with
    | some (φ, a, b) => some (φ, k a y, k b y)
    | none => (splitCond y).map fun (φ, a, b) => (φ, k x a, k x b)

/-- Every comparison over a `cond` rewritten by cases: `(φ ∧ A) ∨ (¬φ ∧ B) ∨ (A ∧ B)`, with `A` and
    `B` the comparison on each branch. Where φ is decided this is the selected branch; where φ is
    unknown it is decided exactly when both branches decide it alike. -/
partial def elimCond : Formula → Formula
  | .cmp l op r =>
    match splitCond l, splitCond r with
    | some (φ, a, b), _ => cases φ (.cmp a op r) (.cmp b op r)
    | none, some (φ, a, b) => cases φ (.cmp l op a) (.cmp l op b)
    | none, none => .cmp l op r
  | .not φ => .not (elimCond φ)
  | .and φ ψ => .and (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .or φ ψ => .or (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .implies φ ψ => .implies (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .always φ => .always (elimCond φ)
  | .eventually φ => .eventually (elimCond φ)
  | .until φ ψ => .until (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .since φ ψ => .since (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .holdsFor m d s φ => .holdsFor m d s (elimCond φ)
  | .within m d s φ => .within m d s (elimCond φ)
  | .untilWithin m d s φ ψ => .untilWithin m d s (elimCond φ) (elimCond ψ)
  | .atLast m d s ψ φ => .atLast m d s (elimCond ψ) (elimCond φ)
  | .count e s op n => .count (elimCond e) (elimCond s) op n
  | .rises φ => .rises (elimCond φ)
  | .definedWhen p φ => .definedWhen (elimCond p) (elimCond φ)
  | .existsUser v φ => .existsUser v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallUser v φ => .forallUser v (elimCond φ)
  | .existsRegion k v φ => .existsRegion k v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallRegion k v φ => .forallRegion k v (elimCond φ)
  | .existsDevice k v φ => .existsDevice k v (elimCond φ)
  | .forallDevice k v φ => .forallDevice k v (elimCond φ)
  | φ => φ
where
  cases (φ A B : Formula) : Formula :=
    let A := elimCond A; let B := elimCond B; let φ := elimCond φ
    .or (.or (.and φ A) (.and (.not φ) B)) (.and A B)
end Formula

      square x, y ∈ [-4, 4] m. The subject's approach lane (region 2, `lane`, direction north,

      a body entering the junction still occupies the lane it came through.

      (region 5) across it at y ∈ [-8, -5]. Each witness says, by `entrance_of`, which carriers the
      line and the crossing mark — the empty list with `entrance_observed` set is "observed, and it
      marks this carrier not at all".
    - the through highway (region 6) x ∈ [-60, 60], y ∈ [-4, 4] and the side highway (region 7)
      x ∈ [-4, 4], y ∈ [-30, 4]. The junction lies on both; the approach lane lies on the side
      highway only, so the crossing way the rule reads is region 6.
    - the car is track 1, a motor vehicle 4 m long and 1.8 m wide, driving north along x = -1.75 at
      one observation a second. Its sight along the through highway is given per scene.
    - the stop sign (device 100) and the yield sign (device 101) govern the approach lane; the
      police officer (device 200) and the signal head (device 201) govern whatever each witness
      says. No witness holds a road user other than the car.

  Each trace begins with the car short of the lane (the rule is then not engaged) and ends at the
  observation at which the car's reference point is inside the junction while its body at the
  observation before was clear of it, so that the entry into the junction is the same instant
  whether occupancy is read from the reference point or from the footprint.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_257_1_o1
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_257_1_o1

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mps (n : Int) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: v ↦ 1

def laneId : RegionId := 2
def junctionId : RegionId := 3
def stopLineId : RegionId := 4
def crosswalkId : RegionId := 5
def throughWayId : RegionId := 6
def sideWayId : RegionId := 7

def junction : Structure :=
  { Build.rect junctionId .intersection (m (-4)) (m (-4)) (m 4) (m 4) with
      ways := some [throughWayId, sideWayId] }

def approachLane : Structure :=
  { Build.lane laneId
      [(cm (-350), m (-22)), (m 0, m (-22)), (m 0, m (-1)), (cm (-350), m (-1))]
      Build.north (enters := some junctionId) with
      ways := some [sideWayId] }

/-- The stop line across the lane, with the carriers it is observed to mark. -/
def stopLine (marks : List RegionId) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect stopLineId .stopLine (cm (-350)) (cm (-1030)) (m 0) (cm (-970)) with
      entranceOf := marks, entranceObserved := true, ways := some [sideWayId] }

/-- The crosswalk on the near side of the junction, with the carriers it is observed to mark. -/
def crossing (marks : List RegionId) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect crosswalkId .crosswalk (cm (-350)) (m (-8)) (m 0) (m (-5)) with
      entranceOf := marks, entranceObserved := true, marked := some true,
      ways := some [sideWayId] }

def throughWay : Structure := Build.rect throughWayId .highway (m (-60)) (m (-4)) (m 60) (m 4)
def sideWay : Structure := Build.rect sideWayId .highway (m (-4)) (m (-30)) (m 4) (m 4)

/-- A stop line marking the approach lane; no crossing marks it. -/
def mapStopLine : List Structure :=
  [junction, approachLane, stopLine [laneId], crossing [], throughWay, sideWay]
/-- The line and the crossing are observed, and neither marks the approach lane. -/
def mapNoMark : List Structure :=
  [junction, approachLane, stopLine [], crossing [], throughWay, sideWay]
/-- No stop line marks the lane; the crosswalk does. -/
def mapCrossing : List Structure :=
  [junction, approachLane, stopLine [], crossing [laneId], throughWay, sideWay]

def stopSign : Device := Build.sign 100 .stopSign [laneId]
def yieldSign : Device := Build.sign 101 .yieldSign [laneId]
/-- A police officer directing the traffic of the regions given, waving it on. -/
def officer (governs : List RegionId) : Device :=
  { Build.device 200 .humanDirection governs (some (cm (-450), m (-2))) with
      humanRole := some .policeOfficer, humanIndication := some .proceed }
def signalHead (governs : List RegionId) : Device := Build.signal 201 governs [.circularGreen]

/-- The car at a point of the lane's centre line, with its speed and its sight along the through
    highway. -/
def car (y speed sight : Q) : RoadUser :=
  { Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (cm (-175), y) Build.north speed (m 2, cm 90, cm 80) with
      sightAlongWay := some [(throughWayId, sight)] }

/-- One scene a second, from a list of (y, speed, sight along the through highway). -/
def run (sts : List Structure) (devs : List Device) (ks : List (Q × Q × Q)) : Trace :=
  Build.trace ks.length 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    match ks[k]? with
    | some (y, sp, sg) => Build.scene t (some 1) [car y sp sg] sts devs
    | none => Build.scene t (some 1) [car (m 0) Q.zero (m 0)] sts devs

    stop line's stopping zone twice, then inside it, then past the line, then in the junction. -/
def noHaltSteps : List (Q × Q × Q) :=
  [ (cm (-2600), mps 5, m 40)
  , (cm (-2100), mps 5, m 50)
  , (cm (-1600), mps 5, m 60)
  , (cm (-1290), mps 4, m 70)
  , (cm (-890), mps 4, m 80)
  , (cm (-290), mps 6, m 90) ]

/-- `forbid` (violated): A side road meets a highway. A stop sign governs the car's approach lane, a stop line is recorded as marking that lane, and no officer or signal controls the junction. The car rolls over the line at 4 m/s and enters the junction, its speed never falling to the standstill tolerance anywhere on the approach from the line's upstream zone onward. No other road user is in the scene. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace := run mapStopLine [stopSign] noHaltSteps

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same junction and stop sign. The car comes to rest with its speed at zero while its body is within the stop-point tolerance of the stop line and short of it, then enters the junction. The scene holds no other road user and the verdict is still decided. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  run mapStopLine [stopSign]
    [ (cm (-2600), mps 5, m 40)
    , (cm (-2100), mps 5, m 50)
    , (cm (-1600), mps 4, m 60)
    , (cm (-1290), mps 1, m 70)     -- inside the stopping zone, still rolling
    , (cm (-1260), Q.zero, m 75)    -- halted 0.3 m short of the line
    , (cm (-860), mps 4, m 80)
    , (cm (-260), mps 6, m 90) ]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The same geometry, but a police officer stands in the junction giving a proceed indication to the traffic on the car's approach. The exception holds, so the rule is not engaged. -/
def idleTrace : Trace := run mapStopLine [stopSign, officer [junctionId]] noHaltSteps

/-- `blind` (unknown): The car enters the junction without halting and a stop sign stands beside its approach, but the source does not report which travel regions that sign governs, so whether a proper sign has been erected for this approach is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := run mapStopLine [stopSign] noHaltSteps

/-- `branch_1` (compliant): A yield sign, not a stop sign, governs the car's approach, with a stop line marking the lane. The car does not halt but comes down to 3 m/s within the stop-point tolerance of the line before entering the junction: under a yield sign the words require no mandatory halt. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  run mapStopLine [yieldSign]
    [ (cm (-2600), mps 6, m 40)
    , (cm (-2100), mps 6, m 50)
    , (cm (-1600), mps 6, m 60)
    , (cm (-1290), mps 6, m 70)     -- inside the stopping zone, too fast to count
    , (cm (-1100), mps 3, m 80)     -- slowed at the line
    , (cm (-750), mps 5, m 85)
    , (cm (-150), mps 6, m 90) ]

/-- `branch_2` (violated): A stop sign governs the approach, and the lane's stop lines and crosswalks are observed with none marking it. The car crosses the point nearest the junction at which the sight along the crossing way reaches the view distance at 6 m/s and enters without ever halting: the third place governs and no halt is found. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  run mapNoMark [stopSign]
    [ (cm (-2600), mps 6, m 40)
    , (cm (-2100), mps 6, m 50)
    , (cm (-1600), mps 6, m 60)     -- the view along the through highway is still short
    , (cm (-1100), mps 6, m 120)    -- the view has opened
    , (cm (-800), mps 6, m 130)
    , (cm (-200), mps 6, m 140) ]

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): neither a stop line nor a crosswalk marks the lane, and the car halts
    where the sight along the crossing way has reached the view distance, then enters. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  run mapNoMark [stopSign]
    [ (cm (-2600), mps 6, m 40)
    , (cm (-2100), mps 6, m 50)
    , (cm (-1600), mps 6, m 60)
    , (cm (-1100), mps 2, m 120)
    , (cm (-1050), Q.zero, m 125)   -- halted where the way can be seen
    , (cm (-700), mps 4, m 130)
    , (cm (-150), mps 5, m 140) ]

/-- `branch_4` (not_applicable): the officer directs the traffic of the car's approach lane rather
    than of the junction; the exception holds all the same. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace := run mapStopLine [stopSign, officer [laneId]] noHaltSteps

/-- `branch_5` (not_applicable): a traffic-control signal governs the junction the car approaches. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace := run mapStopLine [stopSign, signalHead [junctionId]] noHaltSteps

/-- `branch_6` (not_applicable): a traffic-control signal governs the car's approach lane. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace := run mapStopLine [stopSign, signalHead [laneId]] noHaltSteps

/-- `branch_7` (compliant): no stop line marks the lane but a crosswalk does, and the car halts
    within the stop-point tolerance of the crossing, short of it, before entering. -/
def branch_7Trace : Trace :=
  run mapCrossing [stopSign]
    [ (cm (-2600), mps 5, m 40)
    , (cm (-2100), mps 5, m 45)
    , (cm (-1400), mps 4, m 50)
    , (cm (-1050), mps 2, m 55)     -- inside the crossing's stopping zone, still rolling
    , (cm (-1020), Q.zero, m 60)    -- halted 0.2 m short of the crossing
    , (cm (-650), mps 4, m 65)
    , (cm (-150), mps 5, m 70) ]

/-- `branch_8` (violated): a yield sign governs the approach and a stop line marks the lane, and the
    car crosses the line at 8 m/s without slowing to the yield-sign speed. -/
def branch_8Trace : Trace :=
  run mapStopLine [yieldSign]
    [ (cm (-3000), mps 8, m 40)
    , (cm (-2150), mps 8, m 50)
    , (cm (-1500), mps 8, m 60)
    , (cm (-1100), mps 8, m 70)
    , (cm (-700), mps 8, m 80)
    , (cm (-100), mps 8, m 90) ]

/-- `history_boundary` (unknown): The recording begins with the car already between the stop line and the junction, inside the line's stopping zone, and the car then enters the junction. No halt is recorded, and the recording holds neither the start of the approach upstream of the line nor a previous entry of the car into that junction. -/
def history_boundaryTrace : Trace :=
  run mapStopLine [stopSign]
    [ (cm (-1290), mps 4, m 70)
    , (cm (-890), mps 4, m 80)
    , (cm (-290), mps 6, m 90) ]

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_257_1_o1"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("v", 1)]
    expected := expected
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["dev.governs"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_6" branch_6Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_7" branch_7Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_8" branch_8Trace .violated
  , witness "history_boundary" history_boundaryTrace (.unknown []) (boundary := "the stretch of the approach upstream of the stop line's stopping zone, at which the car entered that zone, lies before the first observation of the recording") ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_257_1_o1
